Father of 'Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah' actor Tanmay Vekaria dies

The father of Tanmay Vekaria, who plays the character Bagha in the popular television show 'Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah', has passed away. This comes eight months after the passing of his mother. The news has led to an outpouring of condolences from the television industry.
